notes: The ASV punctuates *to cause his name to dwell in, there thou shalt sacrifice*; both the resumptive *in* and the fronted *there* are taken as the one `שָׁם` realized twice under rule 25. The competing reading leaves *there* `added`.

`מוֹעֵד צֵאתְךָ` is read as a construct relation despite MACULA's absolute tag on `מוֹעֵד`, so the *that* goes to the infinitive as nomen rectum (rules 19, 52) rather than being an `added` subordinator under rule 55; this parallels `יוֹם צֵאתְךָ` at DEU.16.3.
`כִּי אִם` → *but* is fused under rule 35 and headed on the governing first particle (rule 23).
